blocks.title: SysAid plan matrix and who each tier suits
blocks.body: Structure and trial/free flags come from SoftwareGlimpse pricing research. Dollar amounts appear only when verified — never invent list prices.

lines.label: Professional
lines.description: Trial available · Unlocks: incident management, change and problem management, service catalog · Suits: teams whose must-have gates appear on this tier

lines.label: Enterprise
lines.description: Contact sales · Suits: teams that need custom procurement

blocks.heading: SysAid cost scenarios to pressure-test
blocks.body: Price SysAid against how you actually buy seats and unlocks — not against a competitor's homepage headline.

scenarios.title: Lean team / free-or-trial first
scenarios.body: Scope a time-boxed pilot; No free/trial flag confirmed in SG data — budget a paid pilot.

scenarios.title: Growing team with gated workflows
scenarios.body: Map must-have workflows (incident management, change and problem management, service catalog) to plan unlocks before expanding seats.

scenarios.title: Hidden / extra cost watch
scenarios.body: Budget risk: Pricing page is quote-led — list price Professional is medium-confidence, not Freshservice Starter certainty. Also check add-ons, overages, and admin time outside the sticker plan.
